name: EmitterSheet
meaning: ParticleEmitter.sheetIndex (+0x20): an index into the 11 effect sprite sheets (s_spriteSheets 0x6d8078, loaded from s_effectSheetRes), or this sentinel

name: EMITTER_SHEET_NONE
meaning: unset: Emitter_Reset 0x52dbe3 stores it; every Emitter_Update* sets the sheet from its parameter block
